description.value:
Duration 1 minute

Seed the Wound also grants its target temporary Hit Points equal to your level, lasting 1 minute. These do not stack with themselves — a second casting of Seed the Wound on the same creature replaces any remaining temporary Hit Points from the first rather than adding to them — and they are lost when the duration ends whether or not they were used.

cinderfall.incomplete: The temp-HP grant itself is a clean P5-shaped rule (`TempHP` value `@actor.level`, on a companion effect) — the "replace, don't stack" behavior is pf2e's own default handling for temp HP from the same source, so no extra rule element is even needed for that part. The blocker is structural: **Seed the Wound has no companion effect item** (unlike Momentum/Season's Turn/Soften, which each got one) to attach `TempHP` to, and this card can't create one (out of scope — a new file). Held at INCOMPLETE rather than MIXED because there is nothing in *this* file to attach rules to; the buildable piece has no home in the 69 files in scope.
